items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: He played a lot of jobs with me off and on, and we played together for Maison Blanche, Annex.

ctx.x: Did you ever work with Burbank?

Burbank worked with me. Yeah? Where? He played a lot of jobs with me off and on, and we played together for Maison Blanche, Annex. Well it was, he got the job, but most of the time he couldn't play, well I used to take the band over.

items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: Just like Kit Howard, Kit René.

ctx.x: I forget the man. The man. Yeah. The trumpet player in Olympia was? Who did you say the trumpet player in Olympia was?

Who did you say the trumpet player in Olympia was? Where did you live? On Oakland Who did you say the trombone player in Olympia was? The trombone player in Olympia was, I forget the name, I don't know. August. Where does he live? On Clairvon Street. Between the new man and St. Paul, I believe. You know where Hank Robinson lived around there? His name is Robinson, I think. Big Ike is a boy. Ike Robinson. Big Ike is the one I know. Yeah, Big Ike. I forgot his name. And what about bass? Thomas Colton. And banjo,…
Well, there aren't many clarinet players called Kit, are they? That's mostly trumpet players. No, no clarinet players. No.
